title: "2. 湖北郧县约177万年前直立人头骨"
subtitle: "Yunxian Homo erectus crania dated to ~1.77 million years ago"
---

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 新的沉积年代研究把郧县人头骨所在层位修正到约177万年前，使这批原位头骨成为东亚最早的一组可靠直立人化石记录之一。

**English.** New sediment dating places the Yunxian crania at about 1.77 million years ago, making them among the earliest securely contextualized Homo erectus fossils in eastern Asia.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 这项研究直接进入“人属何时、以多快速度走出非洲并扩散到东亚”的核心争论，但新年代也与近年来对郧县头骨形态和系统发育位置的研究形成张力，因此应视为重新打开关键问题，而非已经形成定论。郧县的新年代与格鲁吉亚Dmanisi接近，意味着早期Homo在离开非洲后可能很快跨越欧亚大陆，而不是经过漫长的分阶段东进。

**English.** The result bears directly on how quickly early Homo dispersed beyond Africa, but its interpretation is contested because the much older chronology sits uneasily with recent morphological and phylogenetic work on the Yunxian crania. The revised age approaches that of Dmanisi in Georgia, suggesting that hominins may have reached far eastern Eurasia soon after the earliest extra-African dispersals rather than only after a long staged expansion.
